description: This file contains benchmark tests for string concatenation functions using the Abseil library, including various methods like StrCat, snprintf, string concatenation, and substitution, with performance measurements.

methods.name: IncrementAlternatingSign
methods.description: Utility function to generate a sequence of integers with alternating signs, including negative numbers.

methods.name: BM_Sum_By_StrCat
methods.description: Benchmark for concatenating strings with absl::StrCat and summing character values.

methods.name: BM_StrCat_By_snprintf
methods.description: Benchmark for concatenating strings using snprintf.

methods.name: BM_StrCat_By_Strings
methods.description: Benchmark for concatenating strings using std::string and operator+.

methods.name: BM_StrCat_By_StringOpPlus
methods.description: Benchmark for concatenating strings using operator+=.

methods.name: BM_StrCat_By_StrCat
methods.description: Benchmark for concatenating strings with absl::StrCat in a single call.

methods.name: BM_HexCat_By_StrCat
methods.description: Benchmark for concatenating strings with hexadecimal formatting using absl::Hex.

methods.name: BM_HexCat_By_Substitute
methods.description: Benchmark for concatenating strings with substitution using absl::Substitute.

methods.name: BM_FloatToString_By_StrCat
methods.description: Benchmark for converting float to string and concatenating.

methods.name: BM_DoubleToString_By_SixDigits
methods.description: Benchmark for converting double to string with six digits precision and concatenating.

methods.name: BM_StrAppend
methods.description: Benchmark for appending chunks to a string until reaching a total byte size.

methods.name: StrAppendConfig
methods.description: Configures benchmark arguments for string append benchmarks with different sizes and chunk counts.
